result.instructions: Tools for Spektrix, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which events are on sale at our theatre in the next 30 days?"; "List the performances of the spring season event for next month."; "Show the orders changed since yesterday morning, with their performances and totals.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Spektrix data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run spektrix_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run spektrix_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run spektrix_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. spektrix_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: spektrix_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List the events (shows) of the Spektrix system, with their descriptions, durations and attributes. Filter by name, on-sale status or a date range of instances (performances). Use a short date range. Spektrix API: GET /api/v3/events.

on_sale.description: true = only events on sale; false = only events not on sale.

instance_start_from.description: First performance date to include, YYYY-MM-DD.

instance_start_to.description: Last performance date to include, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: spektrix_list_event_instances
tools.title: List performances of an event
tools.description: List the performances (instances) of one event between two dates, with their start times and on-sale status. Get the event id from spektrix_list_events. Spektrix API: GET /api/v3/events/{id}/instances.

tools.name: spektrix_list_instances
tools.title: List performances
tools.description: List performances (instances) across all events for a date range, optionally for one event name. Use a short date range; the vendor recommends small date batches. Spektrix API: GET /api/v3/instances.

event_name.description: Only performances of this event name.

tools.name: spektrix_list_memberships
tools.title: List memberships
tools.description: List the memberships this Spektrix system sells (id, name and description). Spektrix API: GET /api/v3/memberships.

tools.name: spektrix_list_order_changes
tools.title: List order changes
tools.description: List confirmed orders modified since a time, oldest first, up to 100 per page (customer id, tickets, seats, performances and totals). To read the next page, pass the since value from paging.next. The orders sync endpoint is Early Access: an error may mean the vendor has not enabled it for this system. Spektrix API: GET /api/v3/orders/sync.

since.description: Return orders modified on or after this instant (ISO-8601 date-time, UTC).
